# How to use this book {#sec-how-to-use}

```{r}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "common.R"))
```

This book describes the `r nrow(SPECIES)` copepod species currently listed for
New England, `r sum(SPECIES$in_book)` of which have a full account so far.

**Finding a species.** Start with the keys (@sec-keys) or the checklist
(@sec-checklist). Species accounts are grouped by order, then by family.
Groups of species that are easily confused have their own pages under
*Common comparisons*.

**Reading an account.** Each account opens with a summary box: authority,
classification, habitat, the original description and other key literature,
and links to external resources such as WoRMS. It then gives a diagnosis,
illustrated morphology, collection records (with a map), and notes.
Accounts marked *draft* or *placeholder* are still being written.

**Names.** Names follow the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS). Where
a name in common use is no longer accepted, the accepted name is given in the
summary box.

**Terminology.** Morphological terms are explained in @sec-morphology and the
glossary.
